famine.name: Famine
famine.start: Famine in {city}: the harvest has failed and bread is short. Grain fetches a high price and people turn to dried fish. It will last a few weeks.
famine.end: The famine in {city} is over. Grain slowly returns to its usual price.

epidemic.name: Epidemic
epidemic.start: Epidemic in {city}: many townsfolk are sick in bed. Workshops make half as much and people buy far less of everything.
epidemic.end: The epidemic in {city} has eased. Workshops and market pick up again.

fair.name: Fair
fair.start: Great fair in {city}: buyers come from all around. For a few days cloth, silk and wine sell like never before.
fair.end: The fair in {city} is over. Demand for cloth, silk and wine is back to normal.
